techniques.name: IPS/WIS/DR
techniques.dynamic_fire_evidence: CORRECTION 2026-08-28: prior runpack reported static_reachable=False and a NO_BEAD claim. That was wrong. The full OPE/IPS/WIS/DR module IS implemented in src/extension_scoring.rs (lines 1505-1900): OpeTraceSample struct (action, behavior_propensity, target_propensity, outcome, baseline_outcome, direct_method_prediction, context_lineage), OpeEvaluatorConfig (max_importance_weight, min_effective_sample_size, max_standard_error, confidence_z, max_regret_delta), evaluate_off_policy() which computes IPS, WIS, and DR estimators plus ESS, plus a fail-closed gate decision (OpeGateReason: Approved / InsufficientSupport / ExcessiveVariance / ExcessiveRegret / NoValidSamples). 6+ unit tests in src/extension_scoring.rs cover ground truth, propensity skew, no valid samples, overflow, and input-order stability. The function names do not literally start with ips_/wis_/dr_/ess_ but the math produces all three estimators + ESS + regret gate as the README claims.

summary.dynamic_fire_evidence_paths: All 7 techniques are reachable in code AND have unit tests. 5 of 7 are wired to existing tracing targets (regime_shift, math_technique_fire for pac_bayes/conformal/voi); CUSUM+BOCPD share pi.extensions.regime_shift; OCO is exercised in the reactor tests but does not yet emit a dedicated tracing event; OPE/IPS/WIS/DR has no production tracing event yet — adding pi.runtime.ope_evaluator.v1 is the natural follow-up.
